title: China's Aizhai Bridge Hangs 330m Over a Canyon — Would You Cross? | China Travel Expert
description:
Would you drive across a bridge hanging about 330 metres above a canyon floor?

That's the Aizhai Bridge in Xiangxi, western Hunan. Its deck runs more than 1,100 metres across a deep mountain gorge, it opened in 2012, and it carries the expressway straight over the valley instead of winding down and back up the mountainsides. When it opened it ranked among the highest road bridges on Earth, and it reportedly cut the old Jishou–Chadong trip from over four hours to under one.

🧭 Expert Tip: Don't just drive over it — the valley viewpoints below give you the full sweep of the span, and that's where the photos are. Early morning mist in the gorge is the shot.
